headline: From a Family Holiday to a US$90 Million Landmark: Dominica Cable Car Project
reviewNote: Genuine Dominica FDI story but not publishable by transcription. WIC News feature states ABL Holdings is building the project, that private 'investors made the majority of US$90 million investment', that the cost 'is expected to reach over US$100 million by the time it completes', and that the Government of Dominica took a percentage ownership stake by contributing CBI shares rather than cash. Three blockers: (1) no discrete closing event — the piece is a retrospective on a project 'now in its final stage'; (2) value not cleanly transcribable ('majority of US$90 million', moving to 'over US$100 million'); (3) country field is 'ALL' but the project is in Dominica — machine-owned, not editable here, so flagging instead. Human call on whether to publish as FDI (parties would be 'ABL Holdings; Government of Dominica') and on the country fix.

Parties/value/type drafted and WebFetch-verified by warrenb against the Trinidad Express source (2026-07-22): IDB Invest 'has approved financing of up to US$500 million' to the ANSA McAL Group, agreement signed.
